results.cypher: MATCH (p:ArxivPaper) WHERE p.primary_category = "cs.CL" WITH p, COUNT { (p)<-[:REFERENCES]-() } AS citation_count RETURN p.arxiv_id AS answer_value, [p.arxiv_id] AS evidence_ids, p.title AS title, p.primary_category AS primary_category, citation_count AS citation_count ORDER BY citation_count DESC LIMIT 3
